title: THE BELT KEYS ARE ROUNDED TILES
why: The styling pass reached the stash cells (v18.32) but the raid belt still drew flat squares with a thin stroke. Each belt key is now a rounded tile with a light from the top, its rarity wash inside the same shape and a rounded ring, matching the stash. Sizes, hit boxes and colour rules are unchanged.
now: The tactical belt keys in a raid are rounded, shaded tiles that match the stash.
